Hi Marissa

Thanks for the summary and for looping in Rishi/Dev. Attached is Amaya's standard vendor security questionnaire (questionnaire v3). A few clarifications from our side:

- Deletion SLA: for customer personal data we require deletion of primary/active data within 30 days of request. Backups may be retained longer for operational reasons, but we expect an upper bound of 90 days for backups unless otherwise negotiated. We also expect the vendor to support an expedited purge process for legal/incident requests.
- Logs: audit & access logs: minimum 12 months retention for regular audits; certain regulated records may require up to 7 years (we'll flag if that applies). System telemetry can be shorter (90-180 days) unless otherwise specified.
- SOC 2: we require a current SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12 months). A PDF of the report is sufficient for initial review; we may request to sign an NDA to view details.
- HIPAA / BAA: Amaya is HIPAA-regulated for certain products; we will need a BAA in place if PHI is processed. Please indicate whether Redwood is willing to sign a BAA.

I've attached the questionnaire and a blank DPA template for your reference. Please return the completed questionnaire and any supporting artifacts (SOC 2 PDF, encryption at rest docs, key management notes) and we'll proceed with our legal/security review.

Proposed next steps:
- Share completed questionnaire + SOC 2 PDF by EOD Wednesday (6/3)
- Schedule a 30-45 min security session for technical questions (Rishi/Dev) - are you available 6/4 or 6/7?

Thanks,

Marissa

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the questionnaire and Lina's clarifications. Draft answers below for the retention/deletion/log items; I attached a quick draft SLA language (Data_Retention_SLA_Draft.docx) we can use as a starting point. High-level:

- SOC 2: Redwood Inference completed SOC 2 Type II (security & availability) for period ending Q3 2025. We can provide the report PDF under an NDA.

- GDPR/HIPAA: We support GDPR obligations via Data Processing Addendum (DPA). For HIPAA, we will sign a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) when PHI processing is in scope.

- Deletion SLA (proposed): Primary customer data (online/active data) - removal within 30 days of a validated deletion request. Backups: retained up to 90 days by default; backup pruning & immutable snapshots may extend retention windows operationally - we can agree to a contract clause for expedited purge of backups within 90 days unless a legal hold applies.

- Logs: Access logs (API auth/access): retained 12 months by default; Audit logs (configuration/change/audit trails): 36 months by default; System telemetry/metrics: 90 days. We can offer extended retention (up to 7 years) for contract/regulatory needs but that is an add-on and may require separate storage/contracting.

- Scope notes: Our deletion process covers persistent storage, search indexes, and embeddings. Cached KV entries are cleared from active caches promptly; however, ephemeral runtime artifacts (in-memory caches) are not retained post-request beyond expected session windows. We need to confirm whether Amaya considers embeddings/prompts as data subject to deletion SLA please confirm.

- Encryption & KMS: Data at rest is encrypted; customers on Private deployments can supply their KMS keys. For hosted customers, we offer KMS-managed keys with customer-managed key options on enterprise plans.

I'll refine the questionnaire answers and insert the SLA language in the doc. Marissa happy to join the call on 6/4 afternoon or 6/7 morning PT.

Rishi Malhotra

Hi Lina

Appreciate the fast turnaround and helpful clarifications. Per Rishi's draft and our internal review, please find attached: our SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), and a proposed Data Retention SLA draft. Highlights below (to make it easy for your reviewers):

- SOC 2: attached SOC2_Report_Q3_2025.pdf (we are happy to provide the full report under NDA).

- Deletion SLA (proposed):
  - Primary/active customer data: complete deletion within 30 calendar days following a validated deletion request.
  - Backups/snapshots: retained up to 90 calendar days by default; we will implement expedited purge procedures that target removal from backup rotations within 90 days of a deletion request where technically feasible. Immutable snapshots and legal retention holds may delay removal; such exceptions will be documented in the contract.

- Logs & retention windows (defaults):
  - API access logs: 12 months
  - Audit & configuration change logs: 36 months
  - System telemetry / metrics: 90 days
  - Extended retention (7 years) available as an add-on or for records subject to legal/regulatory obligations (requires advance notice).

- Scope clarifications: Our deletion process covers stored prompts, embeddings, generated content, and persisted model outputs. Runtime in-memory caches are ephemeral and not persisted beyond request lifetimes; KV caches are evicted per configured TTLs but persisted caches are included in deletion.

- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood will sign a BAA for customers processing PHI. We'll include a standard BAA template in the next bundle.

Next steps:
1) I've attached the completed questionnaire draft (answers inline) and the SOC2 PDF. Please review and let us know items you want to discuss in the security session.
2) Proposed security working session: Thu 6/4 11:00-11:30 PT or Mon 6/7 09:00-09:30 PT. Rishi & Dev will join. Which works better for your team?
3) If the SLA language looks good, we can add it to the commercial SOW and proceed to legal review / DocuSign.

Thanks looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
